name: ${mod_name}
description: Villagers live a whole life: they work, build their houses and their town by hand, marry and raise children, trade with real coins at the village stall, elect a mayor and talk about all of it in English and Russian voices. A finished town raises the Spire of the Architects: a hundred floors of guards, keepers and trials beyond its walls.
contributors: Voices made with local text-to-speech; sound effects and music made with ElevenLabs and Lyria through fal.
